name: Inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis with inositol transport
rationale: Members cover inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis across compartments, nudix-type diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis and inositol transporters, whereas confusables add PIP/PTEN signalling or nucleotide interconversion instead of ER-lumen IP synthesis and inositol transport.

name: Prostate gland and male genitalia development
rationale: All members concern prostate budding, branching, epithelial differentiation and growth plus male genitalia morphogenesis, distinguishing it from mammary, salivary, female tract and gonad development confusables.

qualifier: via G beta-gamma to PI3Kgamma and PLC beta
name: Lipid-mediator GPCR signalling via G beta-gamma effectors
rationale: Members are prostanoid, leukotriene and sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor signalling with G beta-gamma activation of PI3Kgamma and PLC beta, which the histamine, leukotriene-synthesis and calcium-signalling confusables lack.

core: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription control
name: MYC-linked control of RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription
rationale: Members regulate Pol I rRNA transcription, nucleolar chromatin and ribosome biogenesis together with MYC target programs, which all confusables lack while carrying Pol I/III initiation or rRNA processing steps instead.

name: Pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear exosome RNA surveillance
rationale: Members span spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition plus exosome-mediated 3'-5' nuclear RNA decay and surveillance, whereas confusables emphasise snRNA transcription, histone mRNA processing and mRNA export.

qualifier: chambers, septa and valves via endocardial cushions
name: Heart chamber, septum and valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover ventricular/atrial myocardium, septation, endocardial cushion EMT and valve formation, distinguishing it from conduction-system, outflow-tract/neural-crest and coronary-vessel confusables.

qualifier: netrin, Slit-Robo, semaphorin and ephrin cues
name: Netrin, Slit, semaphorin and ephrin axon guidance and sprouting
rationale: Members are axon guidance receptor systems (DCC, ROBO, plexin, EPH, L1, DSCAM) plus axon sprouting and regeneration, covering cue families that each confusable lacks in part.

name: Synapse maturation and modulation of synaptic transmission
rationale: Members regulate neuron and synapse maturation, pre/postsynaptic organization, transmitter release/uptake and LTP, without the clathrin endocytosis, vesicle recycling and receptor trafficking of the confusables.

name: Activin-FSH axis in Sertoli cell and testis development
rationale: Members combine activin/follistatin, AMH and FSH/LH secretion signalling with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, contrasting with the ovarian follicle and GnRH-response confusables.

name: Regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation
rationale: All members regulate granulocyte/neutrophil chemotaxis, migration and diapedesis, while confusables add formyl peptide receptor responses, degranulation or integrin-mediated T cell migration.

name: Deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay and miRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover poly(A) shortening, P-body assembly, miRNA-directed mRNA destabilization and target-directed miRNA degradation, unlike confusables centred on miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and translational repression.

name: Pancreatic progenitor and neuroendocrine lineage differentiation
rationale: Members describe pancreatic progenitor, ductal, endocrine and exocrine lineage programs with HNF-driven and neuroendocrine/adrenal differentiation, distinct from the intestinal epithelium, definitive endoderm and beta-cell insulin secretion confusables.

name: Retinoid metabolism, visual cycle and phototransduction
rationale: Members span vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism, rod and cone retinoid cycles, opsins and phototransduction with their disease variants, separating it from retinal development and vitamin D/K confusables.

name: APC/C regulation and Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch at mitotic exit
rationale: All members concern APC/C control and substrate degradation in anaphase, and the Cdc20-to-Cdh1 conversion, Cdh1 autodegradation and RB1 mitotic-exit members are what the APC/C confusables lack.

qualifier: capping, recombination and DNA topological remodelling
name: Telomere capping, recombination and DNA topological remodelling
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, recombination-based maintenance, D-loop/t-circle control and DNA topology, R-loop and fork-reversal remodelling, distinct from C-strand synthesis and replication-stress checkpoint confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated T cell adhesion and immunological synapse formation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, lymphocyte adhesion/aggregation, T cell polarity and immunological synapse formation, which the CD28-Vav1, homing and extravasation confusables lack.

name: Store-operated calcium entry and ER-mitochondria calcium transfer
rationale: Members concern ER calcium depletion, store-operated entry, cytosolic calcium sensing and mitochondrial calcium uptake at ER-mitochondria contacts, unlike confusables centred on ryanodine/caffeine-sensitive release and voltage-gated channels.

name: Naive and memory B cell signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive and memory B cell surface/expression signatures and memory responses, lacking the germinal centre, plasma cell and Tfh members of the confusables.

name: Nucleotide-sugar transport and its congenital glycosylation defects
rationale: Members are nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporter function into the secretory pathway and their disease variants, plus UDP-glucuronate formation, unlike N-glycan, GPI, glycosphingolipid or sialic acid synthesis confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte ion homeostasis and excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members concern cardiac membrane potential, ion homeostasis and calcium-release control of contraction, distinct from conduction-system, Na/Ca exchanger and contractile-force confusables.

qualifier: cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessels
name: Cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessel formation
rationale: Members cover mesoderm fate, second heart field specification, heart tube and pericardium morphogenesis plus coronary vasculogenesis and vascular smooth muscle, which the chamber, valve and conduction confusables lack.

qualifier: migration, proliferation and fusion in regeneration
name: Myoblast migration, proliferation and fusion in muscle regeneration
rationale: All three members are pro-myogenic myoblast migration, proliferation and fusion steps, while confusables concern negative regulation of myogenesis, differentiation or satellite cell maintenance.

qualifier: alkylation reversal, crosslink repair and active demethylation
name: Base excision repair, alkylation reversal, crosslink repair and DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects, direct alkylation reversal, interstrand crosslink repair and TET-TDG demethylation, distinct from translesion, mismatch repair and RNA/DNA editing confusables.

name: Bidirectional regulation of apoptotic mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
rationale: All members positively or negatively regulate apoptotic MOMP and cytochrome c release, while confusables name BH3-only, BAX/BAK, apoptosome or oxidative-stress triggers.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid, peptide and urate transport
rationale: Members are plasma membrane carriers for amino acids, oligopeptides, polyamines, urate and organic ions with their renal aminoaciduria/hypouricemia defects, unlike hexose, monocarboxylate and TCA-intermediate transport confusables.
